description: pipe-elbow-fuse's pipe moved along its axis by a quarter of a tolerance (1e-7), into the bend (d > 0) and away from it (d < 0), pushed in by a whole tolerance, and grown by half of one (g): the ends of the band either side of the tube-circle contact that hold, and the two variants of the survey's regression fixture that steps 2 to 5c fixed. Four tolerances either way is regression/pipe-elbow-a-tolerance-off's (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 9, the band's ends).
